title.zh-CN: 右下腹痛、发热与黏液便 · 4岁3月男孩
title.en: Right lower abdominal pain, fever and mucus stools · boy aged 4 years 3 months

summary.zh-CN: 幼儿持续发热腹痛伴腹泻，外科局部发现可能只解释部分病程。
summary.en: Persistent pain, fever and diarrhoea in a young child may not be fully explained by a local surgical finding.

text.zh-CN: 阑尾为急性单纯性及肉芽肿性炎症，病理提示Crohn累及；术后第2天仍稀黏液便、腹痛发热，无肉眼血便。原文无完整内镜和小肠分期。
text.en: Appendix showed acute simple and granulomatous inflammation, interpreted as possible Crohn involvement. Loose mucus stools, pain and fever persisted on day 2 without visible blood. Complete endoscopic and small-bowel staging is absent.

prompt.zh-CN: 手术发现能否解释全部病程？
prompt.en: Do the operative findings explain the entire course?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 局部炎症之外需考虑持续肠道炎症性疾病及其他肉芽肿病因
text.en: Consider broader inflammatory bowel disease and other granulomatous causes beyond local inflammation

feedback.zh-CN: 较长病程和持续黏液腹泻需要进一步内科评估。
feedback.en: The prolonged course and mucus diarrhoea need further medical assessment.

text.zh-CN: 切除阑尾后无需关注继续腹泻
text.en: Ongoing diarrhoea needs no attention after appendectomy

feedback.zh-CN: 持续症状是重新评估的重要信息。
feedback.en: Persistent symptoms are an important reassessment signal.

text.zh-CN: 淋巴结大可排除外科急腹症
text.en: Enlarged nodes exclude surgical disease

feedback.zh-CN: 影像单一表现不排除腹膜刺激征的病因。
feedback.en: A single imaging finding does not dismiss peritoneal signs.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 肉芽肿提示Crohn方向，但需排除感染并完整评估分布
text.en: Granulomas support consideration of Crohn disease but require infection exclusion and full extent assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 病理提示不是自动完成所有诊断和分期。
feedback.en: A suggestive pathology report does not complete diagnosis and staging.

text.zh-CN: 任何阑尾肉芽肿都特异等于Crohn
text.en: Any appendiceal granuloma is specific for Crohn disease

text.zh-CN: 没有肉眼血便即可排除IBD
text.en: No visible blood excludes IBD

feedback.zh-CN: 临床表现可无明显出血。
feedback.en: IBD can present without visible bleeding.

prompt.zh-CN: 持续症状应怎样衔接照护？
prompt.en: How should continuing symptoms be followed up?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 儿外与儿消化联合复核病理、感染、营养和全肠评估
text.en: Paediatric surgery and gastroenterology should review pathology, infection, nutrition and full bowel assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 不凭一段阑尾病理自行启动长期免疫抑制。
feedback.en: Do not self-initiate long-term immunosuppression from appendiceal histology alone.

text.zh-CN: 归为正常术后反应，无需复评
text.en: Dismiss all symptoms as normal postoperative recovery

feedback.zh-CN: 持续发热腹泻不能自动视为正常。
feedback.en: Persistent fever and diarrhoea are not automatically normal.

text.zh-CN: 未排除感染就照搬长期激素方案
text.en: Copy a prolonged steroid regimen before infection assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 需要专科鉴别和风险评估。
feedback.en: Specialist differential and safety assessment are needed.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：比较局部急腹症与较长炎症性病程。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：完整内镜、影像、感染排除、营养生长及后续治疗。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Compare a local surgical process with the longer inflammatory course. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Complete endoscopy, imaging, infection exclusion, growth/nutrition and subsequent therapy. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 报告诊断Crohn病合并Meckel憩室炎，阑尾肉芽肿提供线索但完整分期资料缺失。
conclusion.en: The report diagnoses Crohn disease with Meckel diverticulitis; appendiceal granulomas provide a clue, with full staging absent.
